comments.body: We should avoid one letter variable names as it is bad practice. Maybe call it either `atoms` or `cu`.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
I know this is unrelated, but can we do 

```
bandpath = atoms.cell.bandpath('GXWLGK', npoints=200)
atoms.calc = FreeElectrons(nvalence=1, kpts=bandpath)
```

It makes the band path object more visible, and it is good practice to set up the bandpath separately because doing so is more explicit

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests a specific code refactor to make the bandpath object more explicit, with a concrete code snippet.

comments.body: When discussing this I suggested removing the previous bandstructure script and linking to this example from the `kpoints.rst`, so we don't have the example in two places
